summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit, a non-traded Maryland REIT, filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K disclosing September 25, 2026 board actions: August 31, 2026 net asset value of $24.95 per Class E share and $24.26 per Class FA share, aggregate NAV of $33.47 million across 1,349,604 shares, new private-offering prices for Classes A, T and I, and a $0.166667 monthly distribution per Class E and FA share payable September 28, 2026. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor or deal terms are stated; watch monthly NAV marks and distribution coverage given the $80.8 million whole-loan and $9.3 million MSR portfolio.
